integrity: The graph-colouring claim is certified by an explicit colouring of all 81 vertices and a verifier that reconstructs all 237 edges from the published definition. Exact chromatic number 3 follows from the colouring and an explicit triangle. Word-representability follows from the published theorem that every 3-colourable graph is word-representable. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result treats only the full simplified de Bruijn graph S(4,3). It does not classify other parameter pairs, determine a representation number, or construct a shortest representing word.
title: The first conjectured non-word-representable simplified de Bruijn graph is 3-colourable
